scope: Optional authored sky logical lifetime and current-camera/shadow scoped readiness, Babylon 9.31.0; no browser automation or GPU/device performance claim

before.note: The original sky had no deadline. before.json records the hidden-mesh/global-gate reproduction. Unrelated global effect behavior is independently demonstrated in scene-ready-scope.test.js with actual ThinEngine.areAllEffectsReady; NullEngine overrides this method so the before probe alone is not evidence for that effect case.

sky.quality: Original authored texture, mip sampling, mirror addressing and anisotropy unchanged; successful texture retained and reused
sky.ownership: Exact owned candidate release and pending removal; unrelated/shared texture ownership retained; abort/dispose/late callbacks cannot publish
sky.failure: Fallback retained and failed memoized Promise evicted for explicit retry
sky.scheduling: Parent main.js overlaps sky loading with map resources and models; this report does not own main.js

screen.scope: Current camera-selected LOD, enabled visible instances, current base material/instanced ink, actual shadow casters including off-camera casters, camera postprocess and enabled render layers
screen.excluded: Unsubmitted disabled retained bosses, unrelated scene pending data and unrelated engine shader programs; no global pending queue clearing
screen.diagnostic: Short named current mesh/material blocker on timeout/shader failure, current counts in scene.metadata.screenReady
screen.statePreserved: Material allowShaderHotSwapping and engine render pass restored in finally; explicit null LOD remains unsubmitted

actualSdkCases: unrelated failed global effect versus visible shader failure
enabled instance with disabled source and actual base draw
off-camera shadow caster and active/stale FoW flag
actual custom instanced village ink and draw
late old Texture completion and explicit retry
20 cached sky calls with no timer/listener growth
verification.controlledBoundaries: NullEngine plus controlled Texture callbacks, material readiness and fake deadline clock. No real mobile GPU/worker throughput measured.

limitations: Logical timeout cannot physically stop an already executing browser image/GPU call; owned late publication is prevented.
Required visible shader/postprocess/texture failure still rejects or reaches the existing 45-second screen limit.
A successful prior sky reuses the existing texture; there is no quality downgrade or asset regeneration.
